tax_emission_correspondence.png.caption: Every marker is a separately verified candidate from the Milestone 9 continuation plus fresh-multistart sweep; no branch averaging is used.

quota_price_correspondence.png.caption: Each target retains all verified quota-price clusters found in Milestone 9; the plot does not assert that the discovered set is exhaustive.

quota_ownership_welfare.png.caption: Total emissions remain fixed at 3. The panels report individual electricity consumption and policy income, not a cardinal social-welfare aggregate.

finite_approximation_prices.png.caption: Signed prices for midpoint finite approximations of the explicit continuum-type target; this stability is construction-specific, not a general convergence proof.

finite_approximation_emissions.png.caption: All midpoint economies exactly match the zero-unabsorbed-bad target up to floating-point error; the experiment is paper-inspired and finite-dimensional.

equilibrium_branch_diagram.png.caption: Continuation and fresh multistart reveal three candidate branches at low tax rates and one at intermediate rates; missing candidates are not a proof of nonexistence.
